headline: Why Is Salesforce Stock Falling on Tuesday?
summary: Salesforce, Inc. (NYSE: CRM) stock is declining Monday after Morgan Stanley downgraded the cloud software provider to Equal-Weight and cut its price forecast to $185.

headline: Tesla Earnings Could Move $83 Billion in Market Value
summary: Earnings set to hit the tape on Wednesday, options markets imply a 5.44% move for IBM and 5.91% for Tesla. Both stocks have seen declines in 2026.
